entries.name: test
entries.description: Test register; its one used bit holds the LFO at its start.
entries.behaviour: Bit 1 holds the LFO counter at zero while set; the source calls it undocumented. Every other bit is stored and unused by MAME.

entries.name: key on
entries.description: Keys the four operators of one channel on or off.
entries.behaviour: Bits 0 to 2 pick the channel and bits 3 to 6 are the key state of its operators O1 to O4: set keys on, clear keys off, all four at every write. O1 to O4 sit at bank offsets +0, +16, +8, +24. Bit 7 is ignored.

entries.name: noise
entries.description: Noise enable and noise frequency.
entries.behaviour: Bit 7 enables noise, which replaces the output of operator O4 of channel 7. Bits 0 to 4 are the noise frequency, stored inverted, so 0x1F is the fastest. Bits 5 and 6 are unused by MAME.

entries.name: timer A high
entries.description: Upper 8 bits of the 10-bit timer A value.
entries.behaviour: Bits 0 and 1 of 0x11 are the low 2 bits. The period is 1024 minus the value, times 64 chip clocks. The value is read when the timer starts or re-arms, not while it runs.

entries.name: timer A low
entries.description: Lower 2 bits of the 10-bit timer A value.
entries.behaviour: Bits 0 and 1 are the low bits of the timer A value whose upper 8 bits are in 0x10. Bits 2 to 7 are unused by MAME.

entries.name: timer B
entries.description: The 8-bit timer B value.
entries.behaviour: The period is 256 minus the value, times 16 times 64 chip clocks, up to 15 times 64 clocks shorter when a 0x14 write starts it. The value is read when the timer starts or re-arms, not while it runs.

entries.name: timer control, CSM
entries.description: Starts and stops the two timers, enables their flags, clears the flags and sets CSM.
entries.behaviour: Bit 7 is CSM, bit 6 unused, bits 5 and 4 clear the timer B and A flags, bits 3 and 2 let an expiry set its flag and raise IRQ, bits 1 and 0 start timer B and A (clear stops). A running timer is not reloaded; it re-arms itself. CSM keys on all operators at timer A expiry.

entries.name: LFO frequency
entries.description: The LFO rate.
entries.behaviour: A 4.4 floating-point step: bits 0 to 3 are the mantissa with an implied leading 1 and bits 4 to 7 the exponent. A larger value is a faster LFO.

entries.name: LFO depth
entries.description: AM depth or PM depth of the LFO, chosen by bit 7.
entries.behaviour: Bit 7 clear sets the AM depth and bit 7 set sets the PM depth, from bits 0 to 6; the other depth is kept. PM depth 0 turns the vibrato off.

entries.name: PM depth (internal)
entries.description: An internal slot where MAME keeps the PM depth.
entries.behaviour: A write here is ignored. MAME fills it from a write to 0x19 with bit 7 set, and bits 0 to 6 are the PM depth.

entries.name: CT, LFO waveform
entries.description: The two CT output lines and the LFO waveform.
entries.behaviour: Bits 6 and 7 are the CT lines: every write also passes the top two bits, as a value 0 to 3, to the port write callback. Bits 0 and 1 choose the LFO waveform: 0 saw, 1 square, 2 triangle, 3 noise. Bits 2 to 5 are unused by MAME.

entries.name: pan, feedback, algo
entries.description: Per channel: left and right output, operator 1 feedback and connection algorithm.
entries.behaviour: Offset is the channel. Bit 6 enables the left output and bit 7 the right (both clear silences it), bits 3 to 5 are the O1 feedback level (0 off) and bits 0 to 2 the algorithm 0 to 7. A reset sets 0xC0.

entries.name: block, key code
entries.description: Per channel: the block and key code, the high bits of the channel's frequency.
entries.behaviour: Offset is the channel. Bits 4 to 6 are the block and bits 0 to 3 the key code; the fraction below them is in 0x30. Bit 7 is unused by MAME.

entries.name: key fraction
entries.description: Per channel: the 6-bit fraction below the key code.
entries.behaviour: Offset is the channel. Bits 2 to 7 are the fraction of the frequency whose block and key code are in 0x28. Bits 0 and 1 are stored and unused by MAME.

entries.name: LFO sensitivity
entries.description: Per channel: how much the LFO bends pitch and volume.
entries.behaviour: Offset is the channel. Bits 4 to 6 are the PM (vibrato) sensitivity, 0 off, and need a nonzero PM depth; bits 0 and 1 are the AM shift: 0 off, 1 to 3 shift the LFO AM value left by 0 to 2. Bits 2, 3 and 7 are unused.

entries.name: detune, multiple
entries.description: Per operator: fine detune and frequency multiple.
entries.behaviour: Offset bits 0 to 2 pick the channel and bits 3 to 4 the operator slot (O1 at +0, O3 at +8, O2 at +16, O4 at +24); bits 4 to 6 are detune 1 (0 to 7) and bits 0 to 3 the frequency multiple, where 0 means half. Bit 7 is unused.

entries.name: total level
entries.description: Per operator: the total level, its attenuation.
entries.behaviour: Offset bits 0 to 2 pick the channel and bits 3 to 4 the operator slot (O1 at +0, O3 at +8, O2 at +16, O4 at +24); bits 0 to 6 are the total level, 0 to 127, where a larger value is more attenuation. Bit 7 is unused.

entries.name: key scale, attack
entries.description: Per operator: key scale rate and attack rate.
entries.behaviour: Offset bits 0 to 2 pick the channel and bits 3 to 4 the operator slot (O1 at +0, O3 at +8, O2 at +16, O4 at +24); bits 6 and 7 are the key scale rate (0 to 3) and bits 0 to 4 the attack rate. Bit 5 is unused.

entries.name: AM enable, decay
entries.description: Per operator: LFO AM enable and first decay rate.
entries.behaviour: Offset bits 0 to 2 pick the channel and bits 3 to 4 the operator slot (O1 at +0, O3 at +8, O2 at +16, O4 at +24); bit 7 lets the LFO AM modulate this operator and bits 0 to 4 are the first decay rate. Bits 5 and 6 are unused.

entries.name: detune 2, sustain rate
entries.description: Per operator: coarse detune and second decay (sustain) rate.
entries.behaviour: Offset bits 0 to 2 pick the channel and bits 3 to 4 the operator slot (O1 at +0, O3 at +8, O2 at +16, O4 at +24); bits 6 and 7 are detune 2 (0 to 3), adding 0, 600, 781 or 950 cents, and bits 0 to 4 the sustain rate. Bit 5 is unused.

entries.name: sustain level, release
entries.description: Per operator: sustain level and release rate.
entries.behaviour: Offset bits 0 to 2 pick the channel and bits 3 to 4 the operator slot (O1 at +0, O3 at +8, O2 at +16, O4 at +24); bits 4 to 7 are the sustain level, where 15 acts as 31, and bits 0 to 3 the release rate.
